purpose: Locate, without displaying or extracting proof content, only the already-named Appendix H structural section of the pinned local QOA source; this addresses the documented NR-H source-location prerequisite, not its mathematical proof or necessity for the target.
independent_basis: Pre-event QOA source identity and v3 source-range qualification, plus the status-only independent preflight results. No held B-program/CLI/source-selection or method consumer is an input; parent exposure history is disclosed, not asserted clean.

source.authorization: Local file only; pinned bytes must match before scan; no web fetch or other source.

operation.permitted_query: Only a section whose heading structurally begins Appendix H, or an A8 section whose heading begins H. Internal heading text is matched but NEVER printed or saved. Count ltx_theorem_example descendant elements only as exclusion metadata.
operation.permitted_output: Only source SHA/bytes, match count, A8-id count, candidate section ID, start/closing-tag LF numbers, example-element count and the allowed status. No source text, heading text, proof, equation, example, bibliography, surrounding context, other section IDs, or external link may be displayed or saved.
operation.stop_conditions: Missing hash, invalid UTF-8/HTML parse exception, zero/multiple heading matches, missing section ID, or any example node => STOP. A matching section is a structural candidate only, not source authentication or proof; no extraction, source-body read by an owner or review follows automatically.

runner: Execute only the frozen python_source, setting SOURCE_PATH and SOURCE_SHA256 exactly from this gate, via the in-session Python eval. The operation performs document parsing and metadata counts only, with no mathematical evaluation, OCR, scientific solver, numerical test, network or output-file writes. Save only the returned allowlisted metadata to a new receipt.
limits: Does not authorize P3, Appendix H prose/proof, examples or any external source to be displayed. A separately frozen exact source-range gate, recipient separation screen and correction-first packet/review are mandatory for any further step. All STOP/HOLD/ZERO, source pause, HOLDv2, L1, recent book/CLI quarantines, N4 UNKNOWN and auxiliary214 STOP persist.
